All items are in natural, unpolished condition, displaying authentic wear and mineralization. The fossils are housed in a compartmentalized wooden display box measuring 14 x 10.5 x 2 inches, protected with clear plastic wrap. Identification cards or handwritten labels accompany each specimen. Suitable for educational use, display, or amateur paleontology collections.

279370366.description: This lot includes four vintage used vacuum tubes from National brand: 2C39 and 7289 models. Made in the USA, these tubes feature metal and ceramic construction. They were typically used as radio frequency power amplifiers in industrial, military, and amateur radio equipment. Tubes show signs of wear and oxidation, with handwritten notes on bases indicating previous use and condition, such as 'R. Final 2C39 5-20-85 USED' and '+V.G.++'. All tubes appear structurally intact but are sold as used and may require testing or refurbishment before operational use. Suitable for collectors, restorers, or those needing period-correct replacements for vintage RF or transmitter gear. not tested
